_about: Push notification copy. One entry per trigger: a title, the settings category it belongs to, where a tap opens, and its variants. A variant's text never contains a naira amount; withAmount is used only when the user has turned on 'Show amounts in notifications'. Variables in {braces}. Admins can edit, add and switch off variants in the admin Nudges tab without a release; those edits are stored in the database and override this file by variant id.
